text:
maya (Sales Ops): FYI — Starlark Systems disputed INV-2026-1022. They say they were charged public hosted overage rates for the first two weeks of Sep while still under a negotiated enterprise tier.
kevin (RevOps): Short version: account migrated on 2026-09-15 but ingestion events dated 09-01 to 09-14 were billed at hosted rates due to a rate-plan flag not toggling during migration. Overage exposure = $62,000. Customer asks for a retro tier price adjustment (40% off the overage) + Net45 for this invoice.
alex (Account Exec): Customer is asking quickly — they want reconciliation before renewal next week. If we don't move fast they may push renewal decision. I recommended approach: remediate full migration billing and offer a one-time concession limited to the affected window.
frank (Finance): Policy check: credits > $50k need Senior Finance and VP notification. Payment term changes beyond Net30 require Credit manager signoff. Also need tax implications and journal entries. Please propose a number <= $50k if possible.
maya (Sales Ops): Proposal to keep this under threshold: apply a 33% concession on the affected overage (~$20,460) for the two-week window and re-bill the rest at negotiated tier. Condition: signed amendment acknowledging the migration window and committing to a 12-month renewal.
kevin (RevOps): If we do 33% on $62k that's ~$20.5k, fits under Sr Finance threshold. Also recommend we create an offset line for the negotiated rate difference so revenue ops can adjust ARR properly.
nora (Legal): I can prepare a brief amendment + acknowledgement. Include language: "one-time remediation credit limited to Sep 1–14 migration window; not precedent." Also add Net45 exception clause if needed.
billing-bot: Automated: Created billing ticket BILL-5021 and NetSuite credit template BILL-5021-CM (status: draft). Link: https://ns.internal/redwood/BILL-5021
frank (Finance): I can provisionally approve $21k and Net45 if we receive the signed amendment and amended invoice before close. If customer insists on 40% ($24.8k) we need Senior Finance approval. Please keep final <= $21k.
alex (Account Exec): Customer is willing to accept 33% + Net45 in exchange for signing the 12-month renewal addendum today. I'll get the signed PDF and upload.
maya (Sales Ops): Next steps list: 1) Nora drafts amendment 2) Alex collects signature and uploads to BILL-5021 3) Kevin prepares NetSuite CM draft and marks Pending Amendment 4) Frank posts credit after attachments.
deals-bot: Automated: Deal desk route triggered for thread 1969999999. Outstanding approvals: Signed amendment, Finance final confirmation. Link: https://internal.redwood/desk/1969999999
frank (Finance): :white_check_mark: Provisional approval logged. Once signed amendment and NetSuite CM draft are attached to BILL-5021, Finance will post CM and record journal entries: Debit Revenue-Adj $20,460; Credit AR $20,460. Also confirm tax reversal if applicable.
kevin (RevOps): Noted — we'll include ARR reconciliation notes and a follow-up watch on renewal metrics.
alex (Account Exec): Uploading signed amendment now. Customer signed and confirmed renewal. Dropping doc into BILL-5021.
maya (Sales Ops): Thanks all. Closing criteria: NetSuite CM posted + signed amendment in ticket. Tagging for audit trail.
frank (Finance): Posting credit now. :white_check_mark: Done. Closing thread.
